result.note: Wrote plan.md and plan-brief.md for step-guard-bypass-forms (3 phases, 13 Progress rows) and set change.md to planned.
assumptions: No human could answer, so scope moves to every form in the goal and change.md 'Direction'.
Unparseable wrapper forms (env -S, sudo -s/-i with a command string) deny with guidance; an unterminated substitution uses the existing exit-2 fail-closed path.

Abbreviated long options match by any non-empty prefix of the denied name, not a fixed 5-character floor, because Git rejects ambiguous prefixes (checked: --no-v and --d fail as ambiguous) and a floor leaves valid abbreviations such as --ha open.
--no-verify is checked only for commit, merge, pull, am, rebase, cherry-pick and revert; pull is included because it forwards merge options.
update-ref denies only --stdin, delete forms and refs/agent-smith/; other ref writes stay allowed because the shared rules tell steps to preserve work in a ref.
Hook-skipping env vars (HUSKY, GIT_CONFIG_*), git config core.hooksPath, git aliases (including -c alias.*) and git reset (mixed) unstaging are left out of scope and documented.
Substitution bodies are located by reusing shellExpansionEnd; line numbers in change.md are stale after the merged heredoc change, so the plan targets current code.
Foundation docs (prd.md, health-check.md) and ADRs are not edited; their wording stays true.
